recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up core FHIR change is indicated for FHIR-25195 unless BRR later chooses to revise the MedicinalProductDefinition search-parameter surface more broadly.
issue_request: FHIR-25195 was Published with resolution Persuasive. BRR accepted adding MedicinalProductDefinition search parameters for contact, master-file, and product-classification so implementations can search product contacts, attached/master-file DocumentReferences, and broad product classifications.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied in acf9332544f24160a237ab7adb2b277301490ecd, whose subject explicitly says it added MedicinalProductDefinition search params for product-classification, contact, and master-file to the then-current spreadsheet source. The current R5-era source was later reworked into source/medicinalproductdefinition/bundle-MedicinalProductDefinition-search-params.xml in 9765a2c28472d45bc31a92cce4687d7c87f338ca, preserving those three search parameters with current element names.
additional_context: MedicinalProductDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini and owned by BRR, so the current resource folder and search-parameter bundle are in core build scope. Later commits changed the same search-parameter bundle, including the already-published FHIR-31861 clarification of the master-file description, but none removed or contradicted the three FHIR-25195 parameters. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no conflicting later decision for this request.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active search-parameter bundle defines contact as a reference search over MedicinalProductDefinition.contact.contact, master-file as a reference search over MedicinalProductDefinition.masterFile, and product-classification as a token search over MedicinalProductDefinition.classification, matching the published issue intent after current element-name refactors.
